title: Муки совести Кости и улика Насти  (Kostya's Guilty Conscience and Nastya's Clue)

segments.t: After Chef Barinov chases Louis back to work with a poem, the female guest assumes Viktor Petrovich is Louis's jealous partner. Meanwhile, Kostya tells Sasha he can no longer hide their betrayal from Max, right before Nastya catches them arguing and notices Sasha's socks.
Да, это он.
И поэтому мне очень срочно нужно и бежать.
За дружбу?
Макс, вспомнил про Макс, у тебя совесть есть?
Я не знаю, как это все произойдет.
Пить надо меньше, как произошло.
Короче, я так больше не могу.
Я все расскажу Максу.
Что, опять случайность?
Саша, Макс должен знать правду.
Я все ему расскажу о нас.
Что тут делаешь?
Носки еще свои.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
Да, это он.
'Yes, that is him.' Admitting that that is him shows Max being honest for a change.
И поэтому мне очень срочно нужно и бежать.

'And that is why I urgently need to run right now.' Saying that that is why he urgently need to run right now is how Kostya sets the tone with Max. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
За дружбу?
'To friendship?' With the plan and point hanging in the air, Sasha puts Kostya on the spot. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Макс, вспомнил про Макс, у тебя совесть есть?
'Max, speaking of Max, do you have a conscience at all?' Questioning whether speaking of Max do Kostya has a conscience at all is how Max tests Kostya's story.
Я не знаю, как это все произойдет.

'I do not know how all of this is going to play out.' Saying that he does not know how all of this is going to play out is how Kostya sets the tone with Max. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Пить надо меньше, как произошло.

'You should have drunk less, that is how it happened.' Since Kostya should have drunk less that is how it happened, Sasha does not waste words on excuses. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
Короче, я так больше не могу.
'In short, I cannot take this anymore.' Mentioning that in short he cannot take this anymore moves the talk in a new direction.
Я все расскажу Максу.
'I am going to tell Max everything.' Claiming that he is going to tell Max everything sounds confident, even if Max has doubts.
Что, опять случайность?

'What, another coincidence?' With the room and point hanging in the air, Sasha puts Kostya on the spot. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Саша, Макс должен знать правду.
'Sasha, Max deserves to know the truth.' Explaining that Max deserves to know the truth lays the cards on the table for Kostya.
Я все ему расскажу о нас.
'I am going to tell him everything about us.' Here being going to tell him everything about them sets up the next turn in their exchange.
Что тут делаешь?

'What are you doing in here?' By wondering what Kostya doing in here is, Sasha presses Kostya for a straight answer. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Носки еще свои.
'And wearing her socks, too.' With the truth and guest in play, Max keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
Да, это он.
И поэтому мне очень срочно нужно и бежать.
За дружбу?
Макс, вспомнил про Макс, у тебя совесть есть?
Я не знаю, как это все произойдет.
Пить надо меньше, как произошло.
Короче, я так больше не могу.
Я все расскажу Максу.
Что, опять случайность?
Саша, Макс должен знать правду.
Я все ему расскажу о нас.
Что тут делаешь?
Носки еще свои.

That wraps up this scene as the female guest mistakes Chef Barinov for Louis's jealous boyfriend, while Kostya tells Sasha he must confess everything to Max just before Nastya spots Sasha's socks. Until next time!
Хорошего дня!
